l1_words.meaning: folder (a file holder, not a carpet)

pattern_explanation: The two words look alike because they are related in form, but their meanings have drifted apart over time. Learners who rely on appearance alone will choose the wrong English word.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word carpeta looks like the English word carpet, but it means folder; the English word carpet corresponds to a different Spanish word, alfombra, which means rug in English.
